title: AI data center build-out faces 'massive' existential risk: Power
title_zh: 人工智能数据中心扩建面临“巨大”的生存风险：Power
summary: Canaccord Genuity managing director George Gianarikas joins Yahoo Finance to explain why power and energy constraints are an existential risk for the artificial intelligence (AI) data center build-out.
summary_zh: Canaccord Genuity 董事总经理 George Gianarikas 与雅虎财经一起解释为什么电力和能源限制是人工智能 (AI) 数据中心扩建的一个生存风险。

title: Exclusive-South Korea's SK Hynix to opt for Nasdaq for planned US listing, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，韩国 SK 海力士计划在纳斯达克赴美上市
summary: South Korean memory chipmaker SK Hynix is looking to choose the Nasdaq for its planned U.S. listing, two sources familiar with the matter ‌said, opting for the technology-heavy bourse to capitalize on investor appetite for AI-linked stocks.
summary_zh: 两位知情人士表示，韩国存储芯片制造商 SK 海力士计划选择在纳斯达克进行其在美国上市的计划，选择在这家以科技为主的交易所，是为了利用投资者对人工智能相关股票的兴趣。

title: Hedge funds sold broader tech ahead of SpaceX IPO, JPMorgan data shows
title_zh: 摩根大通数据显示，对冲基金在 SpaceX IPO 之前出售了更广泛的技术
summary: Hedge funds sold out of the biggest U.S. tech stocks, and some even added ‌bearish positions, according to data from a JPMorgan note late ‌Thursday, just before SpaceX was set to go public on Friday.
summary_zh: 摩根大通周四晚间的一份报告数据显示，就在 SpaceX 定于周五上市之前，对冲基金抛售了美国最大的科技股，一些对冲基金甚至增加了看跌头寸。

title: Expect 'robust capability' from this KKR-backed AI venture: CEO
title_zh: 首席执行官：期待 KKR 支持的人工智能企业拥有“强大的能力”
summary: A group led by investment firm KKR (KKR) is devoting $10 billion into a new AI data center venture, Helix Digital Infrastructure, headed by former Amazon Web Services (AMZN) CEO Adam Selipsky.
summary_zh: 由投资公司 KKR (KKR) 领导的集团正在向一家新的人工智能数据中心企业 Helix Digital Infrastructure 投入 100 亿美元，该企业由前亚马逊网络服务 (AMZN) 首席执行官 Adam Selipsky 领导。

title: SpaceX takes unconventional route to pricing its stock ahead of IPO
title_zh: SpaceX 在 IPO 前采取非常规方式对其股票定价
summary: It's SpaceX IPO Eve (SPAX.PVT) and Elon Musk's space company is setting its IPO price on Thursday night, taking an alternate route to offer stock at $135 per share rather than a general range.
summary_zh: SpaceX IPO 前夕 (SPAX.PVT) 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的太空公司将于周四晚设定 IPO 价格，采取另一种方式以每股 135 美元而非一般价格发行股票。

title: SpaceX ETFs are coming in hot. What should investors expect post-IPO?
title_zh: SpaceX ETF 即将火爆。首次公开募股后投资者应该期待什么？
summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre explains what investors should expect from SpaceX's (SPAX.PVT) planned initial public offering (IPO) on Friday, outlines the leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) coming out for SpaceX, and examines historical post-IPO market...
summary_zh: 雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 解释了投资者对 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 计划于周五进行的首次公开募股 (IPO) 的预期，概述了 SpaceX 推出的杠杆交易所交易基金 (ETF)，并审视了历史上的 IPO 后市场……

title: Why Elon Musk is the 'king of big ideas'
title_zh: 为什么埃隆·马斯克是“大创意之王”
summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) is on the launchpad, just one day away from its scheduled IPO.
summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 已登上发射台，距离预定的首次公开募股 (IPO) 仅剩一天。

title: Siri upgrades show promise, but questions remain
title_zh: Siri 升级显示出希望，但问题仍然存在
summary: Fresh off Apple’s (AAPL) WWDC, Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination to break down the highlights and shortcomings of Apple’s latest announcement, including a closer look at the company’s upgraded Siri AI.
summary_zh: 刚刚结束苹果 (AAPL) WWDC 的雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 与乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 一起探讨了市场统治地位，详细分析了苹果最新公告的亮点和缺点，包括仔细研究了该公司升级后的 Siri AI。

title: How Apple rebuilt Siri with Google's AI
title_zh: Apple 如何利用 Google 的 AI 重建 Siri
summary: Apple's new smarter version of Siri gets its brains from Google.
summary_zh: 苹果新推出的更智能的 Siri 版本的灵感来自于谷歌。
